findings.detail: The new document supervisor can terminate its test process while leaving nested commands running. command() replaces the enclosing deadline with a fresh timeout, and each nested command starts a separate session. If the 285-second document deadline expires during an inner command or pipeline, document cleanup cannot reach that separate process group, and terminating the test process bypasses its cleanup code.
findings.evidence: tests/run_checked_budget.py:19 supervises the document through core.command(). checked_core.py:190 creates a fresh deadline without consulting ACTIVE_DEADLINE or CHECKED_EXECUTION_DEADLINE; line 208 overwrites the exported deadline, and lines 217-218 create a new session. live_group() selects only the supervised PGID. pipeline_command() likewise creates fresh execution and cleanup deadlines at lines 969-971.
findings.title: Parallel paths: nested supervisors discard the enclosing document deadline

findings.detail: Document accounting counts only baseline, red and restored checks. Each mutation also executes Git initialization, patch validation and patch application, each with the same independent timeout and cleanup allowance. For checked-plant-guards-2.md, the validator accepts 270 seconds, but the six supervised commands per mutation permit 540 seconds across its two mutations, before file operations. Load can therefore exhaust the 285-second driver budget while every individual command remains within its allowance, interrupting the required restored check.
findings.evidence: document_budgets() computes 3 * (check budget + cleanup margin). checked-plant:140-151 and 169 execute three checks plus three separately supervised Git commands. tests/checked_plant_test.py:1094 assigns the declared budget as the manifest timeout, which those Git commands also use. The policy assigns two 30-second mutations to checked-plant-guards-2.md: accounting is 2*3*(30+15)=270, while their command allowances total 2*6*(30+15)=540.
findings.title: Boundary arithmetic: document totals omit Git setup and patch commands
